taskDefinition.name: Utility XML to PDF
taskDefinition.author: support@kineticdata.com
taskDefinition.description: This handler will create a PDF file from provided HTML code. A signature (or any other Submission attachment) can be included dynamically. The PDF file is uploaded to the Kinetic Filestore and the resulting file description is returned. The file description can be used with a subsequent handler to update an attachment field on a submission.

parameter.label: Error Handling
parameter.tooltip: Determine what to return if an error is encountered.

parameter.label: Kapp Slug
parameter.tooltip: The kapp to upload the file to.

parameter.label: Form Slug
parameter.tooltip: The form to upload the file to.

parameter.label: Filename
parameter.tooltip: The name to give the created file without the 'pdf' extension.

parameter.label: Image Attachment Mappings
parameter.tooltip: A JSON object that maps how attachments fields should be processed. This format is very specific: {""{"attachment_field_name": {"tag_pattern": "##_*##", "image_template":""}}}. If the tag_pattern is left off, the ##_*## is used as the tag; If the image_template is left off, is used.

parameter.label: XHTML
parameter.tooltip: Well formed XHTML input as string. Use the tag pattern(s) specified in the Attachment Mappings input (i.e., "##Signature_*##") to indicate where the image elements should appear.
